Messages.Author: Name Withheld
Messages.Body:
I have a question about the text of this card:

"Only usable by a ready untapped minion with a gun other than the acting
minion.
The blocking minion gets -1 intercept."

So I bleed with Dollface, Normal with a .44 immediately plays Suppressing
Fire. Now any blocking minion will have -1 intercept.

The card doesn't say only usable when an action is blocked (although the
second sentence does appear to be worded to suggest that, it's still
ambiguous).

Ruling?

NW

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Name Withheld wrote:
> I have a question about the text of this card:
>
> "Only usable by a ready untapped minion with a gun other than the acting
> minion.
> The blocking minion gets -1 intercept."
>
> So I bleed with Dollface, Normal with a .44 immediately plays Suppressing
> Fire. Now any blocking minion will have -1 intercept.

No. The blocking minion gets -1 intercept.
Normal cannot play SF "immediately", since there is no blocking minion.

> The card doesn't say only usable when an action is blocked (although the
> second sentence does appear to be worded to suggest that, it's still
> ambiguous).
>
> Ruling?

"The blocking minion", not "any minion attempting to block".
